method: Twelve prospective synthetic whole-agreement cases, six contrast pairs. Existing context-effects system wording and typed output retained. Expectations never sent to model. Primary result is first response, with false acceptance and false refusal separate; reversed order repeats test stability only. No prompt or case changes after first inference. Current app manual-review behavior is a separate baseline, not model accuracy.
